findings.summary: stuckKey is pr|headSha; a headSha change between ticks closes the old stall and opens a new one, filing a second Decision and notification. Key on PR number or keep first-seen headSha.

findings.summary: hasStuckViolation uses > but checkStuckPrs opens the stall at >=; at exactly the threshold status --check exits 0 with a stall open. Use >=.
findings.title: pipeline-cli/src/hierarchy/status.ts: hasstuckviolation uses > but checkstuckprs opens the stall at >=; at exactly the threshold status --check exits 0 with a stall open. use >=.

findings.summary: finishPush records 'done' before verify and mark-ready; a refusal then records a second outcome via giveUp. Record once after the finish steps.
